verses.en: Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?
verses.sm: Tavita. t E toni ea ua le tautala le amiotonu? Ina tautala mai ia outou. Outou le fanau a tagata, ia outou faamasino ma le saʻo.

verses.en: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.
verses.sm: E moni, ua outou galulue ma le loto i mea leaga; ua outou fuatia atu le sauaga a outou lima i le nuu.

verses.en: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.
verses.sm: Ua liliu ese o e amio leaga talu ina fanau mai; talu ina fanau mai ua sese i latou, ua tala pepelo.

verses.en: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: they are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear;
verses.sm: O iate i latou mea oona e tusa ma le mea oona i le gata; e pei o le asipi tutuli ua ia punitia ona taliga;

verses.en: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.
verses.sm: ole na te le faalogoina atu le leo o e taufaaoleole gata, o loo faaoleole i le taufaaoleolega poto.

verses.en: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O LORD.
verses.sm: Le Atua e, ia e pawa o latou nifo i o latou gutu; le ALII e, ia e tuimomomoina gao o leona taanoa.

verses.en: Let them melt away as waters which run continually: when he bendeth his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.
verses.sm: Ia liu suāvai i latou, ia pei o le vai ona mavae atu; a lolou le aufana e fana atu i ana u, ia peiseai ua vavaeeseina ia.

verses.en: As a snail which melteth, let every one of them pass away: like the untimely birth of a woman, that they may not see the sun.
verses.sm: Epeio le sisi vao ona liu suávai ia mavae atu o ia; e pei o le fanau le au a le fafine, aua neʻi latou iloa le la.

verses.en: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in his wrath.
verses.sm: Ao lei lagona e a outou ulo le afi laau tuitui, pe mata pe mu, na te faaleleaeseina i latou i le afā.

verses.en: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.
verses.sm: E 6a6a le ua amiotonu pe a iloa e ia le taui; e mulumulu ona vae i le toto o le ua amio leaga.

verses.en: So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.
verses.sm: Ona faapea ane ai lea o tagata, E moni, ua fai le taui mo le ua amiotonu; e moni, o le Atua o le faamasino o ia i le lalolagi.
